basics.name: Muhammad Ahmad
basics.label: AI/ML Engineer
basics.summary: AI/ML engineer with hands-on production experience shipping autonomous agent systems, real-time voice AI, and ML classifiers end to end. Built and deployed 7+ production systems, including a voice agent at sub-1-second latency and a text classifier reaching 100% task recall at 12.7ms inference. Strong backend foundation (FastAPI, multi-database systems) paired with a rigorous, metrics-driven ML experimentation practice.

work.name: VaconAI
highlights: Built a knowledge-graph service spanning three databases (Neo4j, MongoDB, Pinecone; 6 node types, 15 relationship types) that converts legal deposition transcripts into queryable contradiction and admission graphs in under 2 minutes end to end

Automated PayPal dispute resolution for an e-commerce payments platform with a 10-agent LLM routing system and a 4-tier offer-escalation ladder, replacing manual case handling with a bounded, trackable negotiation flow
Designed and shipped a small-talk filter for voice agents, running an 11-track ML experimentation process from a baseline logistic-regression model through to a distilled cross-encoder
Reached 100% task recall and 92.9% chitchat rejection at 12.7ms inference latency, meeting a strict recall-floor constraint required for production voice-agent deployment

work.name: Arbisoft
highlights: Built a six-phase autonomous content pipeline (keyword research, pillar/cluster mapping, live-ranking content briefs, generation, on-page optimization) orchestrated through the Claude Code CLI in headless mode, publishing 364+ verified-live articles across 13 sites

Replaced two separate hardcoded Python systems (research/drafting and video rendering) with a single Discord-controlled agent that reads its own operating rules from markdown files instead of code, turning most new requirements into a documentation edit instead of a deploy

Built a quality-scoring gate (numeric threshold plus a banned-phrase filter for AI-sounding language) that ships strong drafts automatically, revises borderline ones, and discards weak ones, behind a hard human-approval step before anything publishes

Shipped 364+ articles and drove 14,000+ views across five YouTube channels over five months of unattended operation, with retry logic that carried the pipeline through transient failures and resumed automatically after usage-cap resets

work.name: Techomnis
highlights: Built the core of a medical transport management system handling 500+ daily trips, covering trip scheduling, status tracking, and client record management
Added a reporting dashboard and data-export tooling on top of the trip-management system, giving staff visibility into daily and historical operations
Built a CSV bulk-import pipeline with validation for onboarding client and trip data, replacing manual row-by-row entry
Implemented backend APIs with advanced filtering, pagination, and aggregation for client management, and delivered a private production deployment with invite-only access control

projects.name: IdeaRadar — Automated SaaS Opportunity Discovery
projects.summary: Scraped 5+ data sources (Reddit, Product Hunt, GitHub, 80K+ Kaggle job postings) with 5 parallel AI analysis strategies. 100-point scoring rubric (Validation 35, Market 25, Economics 20, Execution 20) with digital viability filtering; MD5-based batch caching for resumable multi-hour runs.
highlights: Stack: Python, Claude API, Reddit/HN/GitHub/Kaggle APIs

projects.name: RAG-MCP — Multi-Source Research MCP Server
projects.summary: Exposed 11 research tools to Claude Code (HN, Reddit, X/Twitter, YouTube, web search) with local-first caching strategy, dual JSON/markdown storage, and 3,900+ cached research files. YouTube transcript extraction via reverse-engineered InnerTube API.
highlights: Stack: TypeScript, MCP SDK, Reddit/HN/X/YouTube OAuth
